title: ENHYPEN WORLD TOUR 'BLOOD SAGA' (HCF 2026)
synopsis:
Broadway Cinemas exclusively presents HYBE CINE FEST 2026 ! bringing your favorite HYBE’s artists to the big screen! Featureing SEVENTEEN, ENHYPEN, TXT and BTS!  EVERYWHERE, WE CHEER!

 

ENHYPEN’s ongoing world tour ‘BLOOD SAGA’ continues to captivate audiences around the world. Relive the unforgettable Seoul concert that marked the beginning of the ‘BLOOD SAGA’, where a mesmerizing dark fantasy comes to life. The members' fierce, synchronized choreography and a spectacular, breathtaking stage design emerge from the red glow and deep darkness. Experience the intense band-style sound and the unrivaled vampire universe that only ENHYPEN can deliver in cinemas!
